summary:
Worked both Error-handling items on shop.lab.test (HTTP only) with read-only requests.

WSTG-ERRH-01 (improper error handling) — DONE: Exercised error paths across the reachable endpoints. Unknown paths return a generic 404 "not found" (x4); invalid/overflow query params on /api/v1/items hit a benign catch-all {"ok":true} (x1,x2); the GraphQL endpoints (/graphql, /api/graphql) return clean, structured JSON errors with proper HTTP 400 for invalid fields and missing query (x9,x11) and a controlled "Not signed in" error for unauthenticated access (x16); /admin/ returns a minimal 401 login page (x13). No error response leaked sensitive internals. Not vulnerable.

WSTG-ERRH-02 (stack traces) — DONE: Tried to force traces via malformed GraphQL syntax, unknown fields, empty/null arguments, null-byte/binary search input, and encoded path traversal on the API (x9,x10,x11,x12,x15,x16). No stack traces, exception classes, file paths, or debug output appeared; all responses were short and sanitized. Not vulnerable.

Notes/leads: GraphQL introspection is enabled on /graphql (x6) and the /search.php?debug=1 verbose flag (x3,x14) toggles a "verbose trace enabled" message — both already captured as recon leads from lane 28; the search debug output did not expose trace contents in these requests. Recorded one info lead for nginx/1.30.5 version disclosure in the Server header. Nothing left open; writes were not needed (engagement is read-only).
